cases.name: Judy D. Poe
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: On 3/13/2024, deputies found her dead near her PT Cruiser at a construction site about 250 yards from the house. The car was wedged between a large pile of gravel and an excavator, with the car’s front wheels “buried in the gravel as if it had gotten stuck,” according to court documents. She had been stabbed in the throat with a “large round stake” that appeared to be a broken gardening tool, documents say.
